text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Huh, a "lecture"?!
choice_data_list: Yeah, honestly...
Yeah, to tell you the truth...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I told them that the academy had asked me to give a lecture to students aiming to become Trainers.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that amazing!
As expected of you, Trainer, getting selected for such a big role.
choice_data_list: Thank you, I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like I'll be busy for a while.
However, I must avoid anything that might cut into the time I spend overseeing Fuji Kiseki's training.
choice_data_list: I'll do my best to make both work!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, don't worry about me.
It's a great opportunity.
I'll be cheering for you so that it goes well!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the busy days began!
After watching Fuji Kiseki's training,
as I was preparing for the lecture...
choice_data_list: (Ugh, I'm getting hungry...)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, good work today.
I brought some refreshments!
Coffee, sweets, and sandwiches.
choice_data_list: Huh!? Thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And also, this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki brought both hands together.
After counting to three, she opened them with a flourish,
revealing a ballpoint pen refill!
choice_data_list: Huh...?! Could it be...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Just as I thought, you hadn't noticed.
I could see that the pen you always use
was running low on ink.
choice_data_list: You noticed even something like that...
You noticed even something like that...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"It's just a coincidence.
Watching you work so hard, my eyes naturally followed."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And another time, just as I was getting ready
to head home after working on a holiday...
choice_data_list: Whoa, rain!? Since when...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looks like there's no avoiding getting drenched on the way back.
Feeling gloomy, I stepped out of the Trainer's office, and...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An umbrella with a note saying "To Trainer"
was leaning by the door.
choice_data_list: Wait, could this be...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I went to return
the umbrella to Fuji Kiseki and thanked her.
choice_data_list: You went out of your way to bring it even though it's your day off?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't worry about it.
I just happened to have business in the library.
choice_data_list: Really...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Truly.
More importantly, aren't you supposed to be discussing your lecture now?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Thank you for your time despite being so busy. Well then, I'll take my leave."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I'm not even sure if "as usual" covers it, but wow, how can someone be so smooth...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her dashing back as she walked away,
it finally dawned on me.
choice_data_list: (So this is what it means to cheer someone on...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with everyone's help,
I worked overtime day after day preparing for the lecture.
However...
choice_data_list: (My concentration is starting to slip...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I collapse listlessly onto the desk.
I have the will, but my brain just won't work.
If only there was some way to refresh myself...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Pardon me for reaching out so late at night.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You look pretty exhausted.
You really are such a hard worker.
choice_data_list: Wha— that outfit...!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the Fan Appreciation Festival is coming up soon, right?
I was just practicing for it earlier.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I'm doing a cheering performance.
To improve its quality,
I'd like someone to take a look at it, but..."
choice_data_list: I see... Please, let me help!
I see... Please let me help!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. And now...
Music, start!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Music began playing out of nowhere!
Fuji Kiseki broke into a dazzling fight song.
And during the interlude came a spoken line...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
――Ah! The passion burning in your heart!
Those eyes shining as you aim for the heights!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Such earnest dedication
will surely be rewarded!"
choice_data_list: Ooh...!
Wah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her performance was so true to life
it felt as though I were watching a stage play.
I couldn't help but be captivated.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-san, clap your hands!
Raise your hands up with me!
choice_data_list: Huh! L-Like this...!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's the spirit!
Let's stand up and let our voices out, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki smoothly took my hand
and led me to the center of the room.
Somehow, this was starting to get fun...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I won't give up, and for that reason—♪
I'll fire myself up—♪
choice_data_list: Fire yourself up...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's the spirit! You can definitely do it! Because—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You, giving it your all, are more beautiful than anyone in the world!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It was like a scene straight out of a dream.
So much so that it made me forget
we were even at the academy...!
choice_data_list: I ended up completely captivated by it...
I got totally absorbed in it...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm glad. If you were having so much fun that you lost track of time, then that really boosts my confidence.
choice_data_list: I feel energized somehow!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps thanks to the light exercise,
my body felt refreshed...
It seems I had been tense without realizing it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, she said she 'wanted me to watch her cheering practice.'
But that was surely just an excuse...
choice_data_list: (Did you come here to help me refresh...?)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you for watching.
Good luck with your work!
choice_data_list: You're as smart as ever, aren't you?
You really are so smart, aren't you?
Thank you, I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you for watching.
Good luck with your work!
choice_data_list: You're as smart as ever, aren't you?
You really are so smart, aren't you?
Thank you, I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh? Whatever do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well then,
that's it for cheering practice.
See you tomorrow, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Do your best.
I can only offer my modest support, but...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"You're working so hard.
It's definitely going to work out!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And a few days later...
The lecture ended in great success.
This, too, was entirely thanks to her cheering me on...!
